verdict.rationale: Fireflies has a public pricing page that lists tier features such as AskFred, real-time notes, team analytics, multi-language mode, meeting search and audit logs, and names tiers like Business and Enterprise. That suggests self-serve tier comparison, but the pack never shows actual prices, a free plan, or which features belong to which tier. Missing for 10: evidence of a free starting tier, explicit per-tier prices, a clear per-tier feature breakdown, confirmation that basic plans need no sales contact, and independent corroboration.
